posts.title: America 250
posts.description: So... the United States of America is currently celebrating its so called 250th anniversary at the nation's founding. It is said that, 250 years ago, the founding fathers from the thirteen colonies had written down the grievance they had to the king, and declared that the colonies would be separated from the empire, and to be "the land of the free." Worth celebrating... not. In Congress, July 4, 1
